_README: Durable aggregate record of the character re-rating campaign. The raw race rows (rating/*.jsonl, ~25MB) are gitignored and may be deleted; this file is designed to survive them. See ARCHIVE.md for the schema and for the questions it deliberately cannot answer.

campaign.scoring: 9 down to 1 by finish order over the nine-boat AI fleet; DNF and DNS score 0
campaign.toolchain: node v24.19.0, playwright 1.57.0 (locked), chromium 143.0.7499.4 / pw build v1200, Windows
campaign.codeHashNote: Shards stamp 30c4272fa461bec1 on this CRLF checkout; the identical tree hashes to 4f6bd728bd731167 with LF endings. Same AI. See BASELINE.json.

Cheer.beat: Out-spike her steady beat — she has no pace off the wind.

Bixby.beat: Beat him to the top mark — upwind he is merely mortal.

Skim.beat: Survive her start, then turn hard and often — she hates corners.

Wobble.beat: Ignores the wind to get there — sail the middle and collect.

Pinch.beat: Stay clean upwind, then walk away downwind — he parks there.

Bruce.beat: Force restarts and tacking duels — he cannot get moving again.

Strut.beat: Push her into maneuvers — every turn costs her the strut.

Gasket.beat: Match him upwind, pull away when the spinnakers go up.

Chomp.beat: Tack early, tack often — the ambusher cannot follow through turns.

Whiskers.beat: Attack every rounding and reach — the train needs straight track.

Vex.beat: Lean on him mid-leg — away from corners he is out of tricks.

Hug.beat: Get ahead early — Hug finishes everything she starts, slowly.

Ripple.beat: Drag her into traffic — clean lanes are where she lives.

Clutch.beat: Do not engage — sail past while he is busy starting fights.

Glide.beat: Perfect upwind, lost downwind — make the runs count.

Fathom.beat: Turn the race into corners — momentum cannot help him there.

Scuttle.beat: Deny the chaos — in a clean race he is just slow.

Finley.beat: Break cover downwind — his speed lives on the beat.

Torch.beat: Let the fire burn out — he keeps nothing through lulls or turns.

Nimbus.beat: Chase him downwind — clouds stall when the wind goes aft.

Tangle.beat: Dive downwind — the trap-setter unravels on the runs.

Brine.beat: Break his rhythm at the marks — restarts are agony for a manatee.

Razor.beat: No weak stat — refuse the fight and race your own boat.

Pebble.beat: Reach across her line — precision cannot fix a slow reach.

Saffron.beat: She bets it all on the reaches — win the beats and it is over.

Bramble.beat: Stay out of reach — alone, the urchin barely moves.

Mistral.beat: Fast everywhere — beat the swift on shifts, not speed.

Drift.beat: Every maneuver hurts him — force gybes and watch him wilt.

Anchor.beat: Own the beats — the turtle only wins races run downhill.

Zing.beat: Survive the launch — the beats bring him back to you.

Knot.beat: Sail into pressure — the nautilus cannot cash a gust.

Flash.beat: Send him upwind — the sprinter's compass only points down.

Pearl.beat: Make her tack — every stop costs a fortune in pearls.

Bluff.beat: Just point higher — Bluff bluffs; the upwind legs call it.

Regal.beat: Race the runs — royalty will not hoist and hustle.

Sunshine.beat: Keep her in lulls and dirty air — no gusts, no shine.

Pulse.beat: Break away off the wind — sticky feet, short hops.

Splat.beat: Just race — his corner needs a miracle and a tailwind.

Dart.beat: Point high and turn often — darts only fly straight.

Roll.beat: Slow him leaving marks — perfect turns, painful exits.

Spike.beat: Point high and stay clear of the horn — he cannot climb after you.

Flicker.beat: Follow the fleet, not the tern — his corner rarely pays.

Croak.beat: Race him when it honks — the bullfrog only sings in a whisper.

Snap.beat: Keep him turning — snappers lose their grip in maneuvers.

Rift.beat: Pull away on the runs — eels do not surf.

Skerry.beat: Give him no gaps to thread — then climb away upwind.

Crush.beat: Everything between corners is yours — especially the runs.

Torrent.beat: Absorb the opening surge — the swordfish dulls by leg two.

Jester.beat: Escape upwind — the joke is on him above the layline.

Breeze.beat: Crowd her at starts and marks — slow to build speed, easy to pin.

Petal.beat: Win the beats — the spoonbill blooms only at the marks.

Stomp.beat: Refuse the brawl and outlast him — stomping bleeds speed.

Crimson.beat: Break away in a straight line — he only shines in puffs.

Viper.beat: Slip the cover in open water — he fades on the long legs.

Skitter.beat: Wait for the breeze to fill — the mudskipper needs a drifter to matter.

Veil.beat: Force maneuvers — the cloak tears in every tack.

Puff.beat: Attack downwind — the dragonet will not run with you.

Lure.beat: Refuse the bait upwind — the runs are a free pass.

Wiggle.beat: Make him steer — wiggling is not turning.

Zeffir.beat: Hold him off downwind — gulls glide everywhere but there.

Scoop.beat: Rush the starts and reaches — the pelican needs a runway.

Popper.beat: Point higher and let him puff himself out.

Frond.beat: Pin him at the start — the seadragon blooms late, downwind.

Bulkhead.beat: Hoist and go — the bulkhead sinks on every run.

Slipstream.beat: Deny the tow upwind, then leave — salmon cannot run downstream.

Blaze.beat: Skip the fight, win the runs — makos idle downwind.

Cruz.beat: Nothing to exploit — get ahead early, because he has no burst to take it back.

Prism.beat: Bury him at the start — a clam that has to accelerate is a clam you have beaten.

Ember.beat: Make the race long — the firefish spends everything in the first minute.

Torpedo.beat: Take him somewhere new — the pike is only lethal on water he already knows.

Flaunt.beat: Sail your own race — every trick she has costs her when the breeze gets up.

Piper.beat: Take her downwind and stretch — precision is worth nothing on an empty run.

Stripes.beat: Give him no errors — the tiger has no plan of his own.

Anvil.beat: Beat him off the line — the hammer needs a lane before it is worth anything.

Paddle.beat: Wait for it to blow — the duck is a puddle sailor at heart.

Etienne.beat: Race him in open water — the crawdad only understands a narrow channel.

Frenzy.beat: Keep it tidy — with nothing to bite, the piranha simply drifts.

Tiny.beat: Just point at the mark — anything above a breeze blows the krill away.

Grip.beat: Sail around him — he cannot follow, and he was never going to.

Splash.beat: Never let him start a run in front — everywhere else he is a barge.

Dozer.beat: Put a lap on him early — the nurse shark needs the whole race to get going.

Muninn.beat: Run him downwind — memory is worth nothing on water he has not learned.

Talon.beat: Take him downwind — all that height is worth nothing with the wind behind.

Latch.beat: Break the tow — nobody has ever seen him accelerate on his own.

Skip.beat: Make it a long leg — he spends everything in ten seconds and has nothing left to carry.

Sable.beat: Crowd her — she sails a clean lane or none at all, and dirty air undoes her.

Seam.beat: Wait for it to blow — she reads the light stuff beautifully and drowns above sixteen knots.

Snag.beat: Force him to turn — a tacking duel is the one thing he cannot answer.

Lunker.beat: Wait for a light day — he needs pressure to move, and he cannot turn when it arrives.

Flare.beat: Let him pick the fight, then leave downwind — that is exactly where he is slowest.

Spar.beat: Attack at every mark — he rounds wide and cannot turn back inside you.

Bloom.beat: Put a beat in front of her — she goes where the wind goes and cannot fight upwind.

Needle.beat: Take him downwind — the precision that wins him marks is worth nothing on a run.

Sovereign.beat: Sail on his wind — grandeur does not survive being covered.

Lateen.beat: Send her upwind — a sail she cannot trim is no use against the breeze.

Ribbon.beat: Take her air — she needs a clean lane and will not fight you for one.

Plunge.beat: Race him in a drifter — he needs wind to throw himself at, and dies without it.

Riffle.beat: Wait for a windy day — she is quick and clever until it blows, then she is just small.

Chisel.beat: Make him manoeuvre — he has no way of finding that speed again.

Chroma.beat: Push her into heavy air — the thinking stops working above sixteen knots.

headToHead.format: [i, j, racesTogether, timesIFinishedAheadOfJ] — i,j index into names[]

legCompositionNote: Measured beat/reach/run fractions per leg, sampled at 10Hz from real races. Chord-based labels in legtypes.json are wrong at nine of ten venues; these supersede them for any point-of-sail attribution.
